ACTION: Dispatch the round 5 fix subagent with model `fable`, as a fresh dispatch because the model changes. The prompt purpose is to fix finding F1 in Task 6. It carries the task brief from `scripts/task-brief`, the F1 text verbatim, the global constraints, and the path to the round 4 fix report. It requires a test that starts the real refresh thread and fails before the fix (red first).

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- A race test that never starts the racing thread gives a false green. Here the refresh thread never runs, so the lock and the invalidation order are never contested.
- A race test is only evidence if it fails before the fix. Red-first shows that the test reaches the race.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

Task 6 is not done. The scoped re-review still reports Important finding F1, the open race between cache invalidation and the background refresh at `cache/refresh.py:88`. The round 4 test passes only because it never starts the refresh thread, so it does not test the race.

Round 4 was a thorough attempt. A fresh opus implementer worked at high effort with full context. The context and effort fixes are used up, so the next step is a stronger model. I am dispatching round 5, the last allowed fix attempt, at `fable` (the top model tier in this runtime).

The round 5 implementer must start the real refresh thread in its test and show that the test fails without the fix. After it reports, I will generate the review package and dispatch a scoped re-review of F1. If F1 is still open after this round, I will adjudicate under the fix-loop rules and bring you the open finding.
